data.title: First reminder: overdue library loan (1. Mahnung)
data.summary: Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) that two borrowed items are overdue, with accrued fees of €4.50, and asks Sam Rivera to return them by 2 October 2026.
data.explanation: The library is reminding you that two items you borrowed are past their due date, and fees of €4.50 have already built up. Return the items by the stated deadline and pay the fee at the service desk or the payment machine when you return them. If you keep the items longer, the fee grows by €0.50 per item for each day the library is open, and once your fee balance reaches €10.00 the library will block your account so you cannot borrow anything else until it is settled. If you have a hold-free item, you may also be able to extend the loan period online.
